name: Securities Transaction Cancellation Request Status Advice V 09
definition: Scope|An account servicer sends an SecuritiesTransactionCancellationRequestStatusAdvice to an account owner to advise the status of a securities transaction cancellation request previously sent by the account owner.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure acting on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) acting on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian acting on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information|using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

CancellationRequestReference.name: Cancellation Request Reference
CancellationRequestReference.definition: Reference to the unambiguous identification of the cancellation request as per the account owner.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Provides details on the processing status of the request.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

SecuritiesMarketPracticeGroupGuideline.definition: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the use of this message.|These market practices are available on www.smpg.info.
